offeringDetails.preparation: [SYNTHETIC] Defined preparation of the measured affected area.
offeringDetails.trimDescription: [SYNTHETIC] Trim with preparation, one primer and two finish coats.

paintingSettings.wallAdditionalCoatRatio.label: Painting additional-coat labor ratios
paintingSettings.wallAdditionalCoatRatio.source: Prosperity Painting Consultants lists smooth-wall production at 210 sq ft/hr for the first coat and 280 for additional coats (a 0.75 labor ratio), and baseboards at 80 then 240 LF/hr (one third). PaintPricing’s wall example uses 9.6 hours then 8 hours (about 0.83). Sources: https://prosperitypaintingconsultants.com/tools/painting-estimate-calculator ; https://paintpricing.com/painting-production-rates/
paintingSettings.wallAdditionalCoatRatio.assumption: Walls and ceilings start at 0.8; trim starts at 0.33. These assume your crew follows the published production relationships. The saved per-coat price is converted from its two-coat basis; extended coat lines round separately. Materials remain per coat. Primer ratios have no starting value.
